newsitem.title: USA: HBO & Co Q4 operating net rises before charge.
newsitem.headline: HBO & Co Q4 operating net rises before charge.

text.p: (000's Omitted Except for Per Share Data)
Three Months Ended Twelve Months Ended

NOTE: (1) 1995 periods exclude non-recurring charge of $35.2 million for the quarter ended December 31, 1996 and $61.4 million for the year ended December 31, 1996. Impact of non-recurring charge is ($.22) per share fully diluted for the quarter and ($.40) per share fully diluted for the year.
(2) 1995 year excludes non-recurring charge of $136.5 million for the year ended December 31, 1995. Impact of non-recurring charge is ($.93) per share fully diluted for the year.
All share and per share amounts have been restated to reflect the 1996 two-for-one stock split.
Results have been restated to reflect the 1996 acquisitions of CyCare Systems Inc, Management Software Inc, and GMIS Inc in pooling transactions.
